Title: SMC AW20-F01E-B 01244327 Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: AW20-F01E-B
DESCRIPTION: AW20(*)-B to AW60(*)-B, Filter Regulator & Filter Regulator w/Backflow Function
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Made to Order 1: None Body Size: 20 Backflow Function: None Thread: F (G) Port: 01 (1/8) Option: E (Square embedded type pressure gauge [with limit indicator]) Semi-standard 1: Standard Semi-standard 2: Standard Made to Order 2: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: This combination Filter/ Regulator minimizes space and piping by integrating the 2 units into one. Standard features include a relieving regulator, which can be quickly locked by pushing down on the adjustment knob.
